headline: Everything since 13 August, before it reaches production
lede: One page for the whole release: what changes for a visitor, the journeys that show it on five engines, and the checks that stay yours.

signoff.lede: Production changes only on your decision. Approving here records that this release may be promoted; the promotion itself stays yours.
signoff.approve: Signed off — may release to production

gapGroup: Shown by no journey: check by hand

checks.label: Open the homepage in all five languages (/, /id/, /zh/, /vi/, /th/) and move between them from the header.
Switch light and dark from the header on all three pages, then reload: the choice holds.
Make groups on /classroom-groups from a real class list, open the projector board, and print the register.
Work out Glory Points on /glory-points in two languages.
Send a translation report from the footer: the page says it was sent, and `npm run reports:review shyden-reports-dev` shows it.
Open a missing page in a beta language and send a report from the 404.
Add the WAF rate-limit rule on /api/report from docs/runbooks/translation-reports.md.
Confirm the Workers plan covers the report function.
Confirm the production Pages project binds the production reports database.
Decide on the DEV_PASSWORD variable found on the production Pages project.
Confirm no Cloudflare secret is held at repository level, only in the approval-gated environments: the repository list was empty when read on 2026-10-07 (#241, #415).
